northStar: One real workflow reaches a measurable outcome through an accountable operating record.

portfolio.name: Company system
portfolio.job: Turn company priorities, product delivery, evidence, exceptions, and owner decisions into one shared operating record.
portfolio.nextGate: Rehearse the private managed-backend contract on isolated hosted PostgreSQL, then prove one end-to-end Product workflow and one bounded agent handoff with attributed human acceptance.

portfolio.name: Website
portfolio.job: Turn an approved business brief into a finite, reviewable website and one deterministic downloadable site file.
portfolio.nextGate: Rehearse one approved managed site artifact into a retained Commerce intake before connecting a customer domain or publish authority.

portfolio.name: Commerce
portfolio.job: Convert Website and trusted-channel demand into controlled orders, stock, fulfilment, payment status, follow-up, and close.
portfolio.nextGate: Repeat the managed Website intake through authenticated human Commerce confirmation across at least two catalog items; then review the twenty-fixture AI Order Intake corpus, run the server-only model evaluation, and connect it inside Orders only after the zero-side-effect gate passes.

portfolio.name: Production
portfolio.job: Connect recurring jobs, output, quality, materials, equipment, maintenance, and shift exceptions in one production record.
portfolio.nextGate: Rehearse the managed job-create to output flow on isolated PostgreSQL, then validate one line, maintenance, or quality workflow with operator evidence and owner review.

researchGates.gate: Compare Vercel Workflows with the existing Cloud Tasks runtime using one approval-wait use case.
Adopt only after durable execution and centralized approval policy are proven.
Redact customer content and correlate request, workflow, model, tool, and database operations.
Adopt TanStack Table or virtualization only after measured row volume exceeds the native interface.
Add only when simultaneous operators create a measured refresh problem.
Reconsider only if the existing relational system of record and worker runtime cannot meet a documented requirement.

nonGoals: One page or domain per capability
